description.value: Sal y Limon is an authentic Mexican restaurant founded by four food enthusiasts, including Carolina, who drew on family recipes from Manzanillo, Mexico, to create a family-welcoming space with vibrant flavour. The Commercial Drive location sits on one of Vancouver's most active cycling corridors and offers both indoor and outdoor seating. It is one of three Metro Vancouver locations and offers online pick-up and delivery ordering.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: wall_loops (3 spaces) at 46m; rack at 58m. Total: 3 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the Commercial Drive location at 1752 Commercial Dr with phone (604) 428-6223, matching OSM exactly. Prominent 'Order Pick-Up' and 'Order Delivery' buttons on every page confirm takeout availability. No evidence of bike parking, water refill, Wi-Fi, or other cycling amenities appears anywhere in the website content; washrooms are inferred only from OSM's toilets:wheelchair=yes tag since the website is silent on the topic.
concerns: OSM name field is 'Sal y Limon' (no accent); website and OSM name:es tag both use 'Sal y Limón' — the accent mark is intentionally omitted in the OSM primary name field.
Washrooms confirmed via OSM tag only (toilets:wheelchair=yes); website does not explicitly mention washroom availability.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active, well-established Mexican restaurant on Commercial Drive — a major Vancouver cycling corridor — with confirmed takeout, outdoor seating, and wheelchair accessibility; a practical and appealing stop for touring cyclists.
